quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): JENOPTIK Canada was awarded a contract by the Insurance Corporation of British Columbia (ICBC) to deliver, implement and install more than 140 intersection safety camera systems combining red light violation and speed on green detection, together with its FlowTris back-office platform, for ICBC's Intersection Safety Camera Program; Jenoptik is opening a new office in Vancouver.
